verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU ekisa kyo-ekingi
Kinjiike ku mwoyo,
Guleme-okukyama nate
Gunywerere ku ggwe.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Omuliro gwa Katonda
Gwake mu nze leero;
Gwokye-amasengere gonna,
Guntukuze-omwoyo.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Eyakka-edda ku baddu bo,
Omwoyo,kka ku nze;
Omwana wo nkukoowoola,
Ebyonoono-obyokye.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Omuliro-ogutukuza,
Gunjiike ku mwoyo:
Leeta-omnusana n'obulamu,
Byake bintukuze.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ne ndyoka nfuna-amaayi go,
Obutasirika;
-Obugagga bwange,Mukama,
-Obulamu bwange-era.
